name: ibis budget Singapore Mount Faber
short_description: A 2-star budget hotel at the foot of Mount Faber, about a 10-minute walk from HarbourFront MRT and VivoCity, with an outdoor pool.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Mount Faber sits at 400 Telok Blangah Road, at the base of Mount Faber, about a 10-minute walk from HarbourFront MRT Station and VivoCity mall -- Singapore's largest shopping centre and the gateway to Sentosa Island, roughly a 10-minute taxi ride away. Formerly branded Fragrance Hotel - Royal, the economy hotel offers five room types (12-15 sqm), an outdoor pool, and 24-hour front desk service. Its own Accor listing shows a strong 4.5/5 guest rating from 214 reviews, with sub-scores of 9.2/10 for location and 9.4/10 for service, though rooms score notably lower at 5.6/10. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

core_facts.elite_notes: This hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, per its own Accor listing; ALL member rates may still apply but no points-earning or elite benefits are offered.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Mount Faber part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Mount Faber from Sentosa Island?
faqs.answer: It's about a 10-minute taxi ride to Sentosa Island and Universal Studios Singapore, and roughly a 10-minute walk to HarbourFront MRT Station and VivoCity mall, which both connect directly to Sentosa's cable car and boardwalk access points.
